top_signals.title: Stocks Fall as Chip Rout Outweighs Inflation Data
top_signals.summary:
Another selloff in chipmakers weighed on stocks, overshadowing inflation data that eased concern about aggressive Federal Reserve rate hikes.
Ted Parkhill, Founder & CEO at Incline Investment Management, gives his market outlook amid fresh PPI data and AI related-volatility. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: German parliament passes law giving spy agencies hacking, sabotage powers
top_signals.summary: In the biggest overhaul of the country’s spy laws of the postwar era, the Bundestag approved the bill by 308 votes to 190 — with 71 abstentions — months after Chancellor Friedrich Merz’s cabinet signed off on the draft.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Hyperliquid’s share of open interest reached 11.7% across the platform and eight major centralized rivals.
